publication.title: Semantic Relatedness as an Inter-facet Metric for Facet Selection over Knowledge Graphs

source_reading.scope: All main sections and references: problem, related work, concrete generation/selection steps, structural relatedness rule and future implementation/evaluation.

adjudication.basis: A concrete proposed facet-selection method uses direct/indirect KG properties, applicability filtering, individual facet scores and semantic inter-facet redundancy checks to select a bounded useful set. This is user-facing exploration guidance through the protocol OR criterion; the source explicitly places system implementation and evaluation in future work.
